en: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

p.src: 1  Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
u.src: 1  Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

p.src: 2  Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

en: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
u.src: 2  Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

p.src: 3  God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

en: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
u.src: 3  God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

p.src: 4  For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

en: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
u.src: 4  For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

p.src: 5  They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

en: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
u.src: 5  They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

p.src: 6  Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

en: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
u.src: 6  Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

p.src: 7  With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

en: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
u.src: 7  With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

p.src: 8  As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

en: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
u.src: 8  As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

p.src: 9  We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

en: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
u.src: 9  We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

p.src: 10  As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

en: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
u.src: 10  As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

p.src: 11  Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

en: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
u.src: 11  Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

p.src: 12  Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

en: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
u.src: 12  Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

p.src: 13  Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

en: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
u.src: 13  Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

p.src: 14  For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

en: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
u.src: 14  For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
